About this alpha
About this desktop alpha

Selected low-voltage families include a 16-part procedural control board and multi-rail control boards with 33, 35 or 37 parts. The 3-part indicator and 4-part protected indicator are introductory practice boards.

EASY and MEDIUM candidates are checked before play. HARD and PSYCHOTIC are unavailable. Only the listed board families are supported. Mains circuits and general multilayer routing are not supported. Use Main menu to save or load a session file. Loading restarts dynamic state; retest the board afterward.
